description: What's open here. Scoped to the current project (plus unfiled items) unless you ask otherwise, and compact by default — one line per item. Pass workspace:"*" to see every project, or verbose:true for full records.

agent.description: Restrict to items added by this MCP client name, e.g. "claude-code"

category.description: Restrict to items with this exact category/tag

inProgress.description: If true, restrict to items currently claimed via todo_claim (see the '▶working' suffix)

limit.description: Max number of items to return (for token efficiency / pagination)

list.description: Restrict to the todo list, the backlog, or both (default)

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination)

session.description: Restrict to items added during this connection's session token (see the 'via' suffix on listed items)

verbose.description: Full records (description, source link, provenance) instead of one compact line per item.

workspace.description: Defaults to the current project (plus unfiled items). Pass "*" for every project, or a project name for that one.

name: todo_list
title: List todos
